details.title: Calibration to the design basis (Muse Wonder session)

reason: Muse's calibration session could not converge a purity spec on D-502. With the documented molar reflux 3.5 (report 3.5.2), a boilup ratio of 0.470 found by bisection on full A500 solves gives 89.7 wt % ethanol overhead against the documented 92.5 wt %; lower boilups that would approach 92.5 wt % do not converge (0.43 and below), so this is the closest converging value. Design-basis target only; the withheld stream tables were not used.
